lucyMemoryReset.title: Reset Lucy's memory
lucyMemoryReset.subtitle: Clear Lucy's memories, conversation thread, and structured knowledge
lucyMemoryReset.confirmMessage:
⚠️ This action is immediate and cannot be undone.

Lucy will permanently forget everything she has learned about you: your preferences, personality, relationships, life events, and your entire conversation history. She will start completely fresh with no memory of you.

This data cannot be recovered once deleted.

Only your mood tracker history will be kept.
lucyMemoryReset.successMessage: The conversation on this screen has been cleared. You can start fresh.
lucyMemoryReset.errorMessage: Could not reach the server or something went wrong. Try again later.

deleteAccount.title: Delete my account
deleteAccount.subtitle: Permanently delete account and all data
deleteAccount.confirmMessage:
⚠️ Warning, this action is permanent and irreversible.

Your account, all your conversations with Lucy, your complete mood history, and every piece of data associated with you will be immediately and permanently deleted from our servers.

Neither you nor our team will be able to recover anything. There is no going back.

Are you sure you want to delete your account?
deleteAccount.subscriptionNotice: If you have a subscription, it is sold and billed by {{store}}: deleting your account does not cancel it, and we cannot cancel it for you. Cancel it from your {{store}} account first, otherwise billing continues.
deleteAccount.errorMessage: Could not delete the account at this time. Please try again later.
